One Connect

Lucia Stancioff

“I cannot speak highly enough of our FirstLight Internet connectivity speeds and consistency. Rachel Heroth

“In the months since we began using FirstLight’s services, we have seen a marked improvement in performance. “With FirstLight owning and managing all of the equipment, the convenience and reliability that come with FirstLight’s SD-WAN and Managed Services have given our team the ability to focus on being proactive with our IT initiatives, versus the reactive state we formerly found ourselves in.”

“(With FirstLight), we now realize big savings, less maintenance, more space to support our mission and we don’t have to manage multiple data centers. Let's Talk

Over 15,000 businesses in the Northeast rely on FirstLight. Find out why, and whether we’re the right fit for you.

Headquartered in Albany, New York, FirstLight provides fiber-optic data, Internet, data center, cloud, unified communications, and managed services to enterprise and carrier customers throughout the Northeast and mid-Atlantic.
We operate a 20,000-route-mile fiber network connecting more than 16,000 on-net locations. Our network is just the beginning…
